units.source_text: 我作为忠实的观战记者，一想到这盘长达半年之久的棋最终将在今天结束，心情也就激动起来。

en.t: As a faithful reporter watching the match, I felt my excitement rise at the thought that this game, which had lasted as long as half a year, would finally come to an end today.

units.source_text: 而且，名人败北，早已是尽人皆知。

en.t: Moreover, the Master's defeat was already known to everyone.
